Stretcher transportation

Lufthansa provides stretchers which allow passengers, who for medical reasons can only be transported in a lay-down position , to travel comfortably. They may however be accompanied by another person on board. Passengers between 100cm and 200cm tall can be carried with our stretcher, with a maximum weight of 120kg. For detailed information about fees regarding specific journeys, please contact the TMC or our Medical Operations Center.
